newsitem.title: FRANCE: France holds seven suspected Islamic militants.
newsitem.headline: France holds seven suspected Islamic militants.

text.p: French anti-terrorist police detained seven suspected Islamic militants in the Mediterranean port of Marseille on Tuesday, police sources said.
They said a police squad was flown in from Paris for the swoop, which apparently followed a tip-off from Germany.
Radio reports said the raid appeared to be part of a series of probes into Moslem fundamentalist networks across Europe.
It was not clear if it was connected with a bomb attack on a Paris underground commuter train on December 4 which was blamed on Algerian Moslem rebels.
